card.name: Into/over after placing an object
card.fires_on: The small word 'into', 'in' or 'over' right after an object being placed, inserted or submerged in handling instructions (straw, tubing, set, needle). Also fires on a few unrelated spots.

modes.label: Placement preposition
modes.description: 'into', 'in' or 'over' after a thing being placed or inserted in step-by-step instructions.
modes.example: Place stay•safe catheter extension set<< into>> organizer.
